name: aos-agent-skill-document
description: Create, edit, inspect, render, and visually verify professional Word and PDF documents.

interface.shortDescription: Professional Word and PDF authoring with visual QA
interface.longDescription: A skills-only document studio with separate workflows for publication planning, editable Word authoring, PDF processing, metadata review, rendering, and page-by-page visual verification. The source repository includes a reproducible TAIZHOU brand-enterprise white-paper case.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable Word report and verify every rendered page.
Inspect this PDF for metadata, layout, and rendering defects.
Use the TAIZHOU case to build a polished brand white paper.
